statement: Published source models disagree on the full-report cadence used as an emulator baseline: generic community 0x30 mode notes say 60 Hz, another community note singles out Pro at 120 Hz, and OpenPuck's emulated USB report schedule targets 4 ms (~250 Hz). None of these is a measured retail USB period.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: bluetooth_hid_subcommands_notes.md 66-78; bluetooth_hid_notes.md 116-118; OpenPuck mode_switch_pro.cpp 20-25. This is model/documentation disagreement, not proof that firmware violates a fixed period.
